words: Added the transaction producer's two members to the 49 Financial gold entry irpt-49f-reporting-gold-lambda in infra/aws/lambda/ci/lambda-source-map.json: account_transaction.py and transaction_words.json, appended LAST to files (22 to 24) and their two staged_from objects appended LAST (21 to 23), in that order, each packaged at its own repo path. No other key of the entry, no existing member's pin and no other function changed; the only other diff line is the comma added after the previous last file.
